headline: Mario Draghi, the 'sphinx' still shaping the EU's agenda
subtitle: At 79, the former president of the European Central Bank, who no longer holds any official office, remains at the heart of European Union politics. subtitle: 'Mao's Fraught Legacy' (1/7). Mao Zedong, who died on September 9, 1976, founded the People's Republic of China and still casts a shadow over the country's political life. headline: French billionaire Olivier Bouygues stands trial for killing protected birds

headline: Why loneliness is now seen as a harmful epidemic for mental and physical health
subtitle: In France, nearly one in four people reported feeling lonely in 2025. This isolation particularly affects young people and the elderly, and could be a significant source of suffering. Among the possible ways to counter it are taking part in local activities and encouraging more volunteering.
